functions.name: CBlocker::Check
functions.evidence: Reads device fence pointer +0x2A90 and state byte +0x2ABD; existing title hook.

functions.name: Direct3D_CreateDevice
functions.evidence: Allocates 0x5E00 bytes at alignment 0x80; r4 selects device type; type 2 sets flag +0x2ABC; hardware path stores behavior at +0x5DAC.

functions.name: D3DDevice_SetIndices
functions.evidence: Stores the bound index buffer at device +0x3094.

functions.name: D3DDevice_SetDepthStencilSurface
functions.evidence: Stores bound depth surface at device +0x30A8; maintains destination state.

functions.name: XGRegisterPixelShader
functions.evidence: Initializes resource type 7 and physical data pointer +0x18 in the shader header.

functions.name: D3DDevice_SetPixelShader
functions.evidence: Stores bound pixel shader at device +0x3194 and applies literal constants.

functions.name: XGRegisterVertexShader
functions.evidence: Initializes resource type 6, physical pointer +0x20, container at +0x368; copies 12-byte fetch instructions.

functions.name: D3DDevice_SetVertexShader
functions.evidence: Stores bound vertex shader at device +0x3198 and applies literal constants.

functions.name: D3DDevice_SetVertexDeclaration
functions.evidence: Stores r4 at device +0x2E2C and marks the relevant dirty group.

functions.name: D3DDevice_ClearF
functions.signature: r3=device, r4=flags, r5=rect, r6=float_color, f1=depth, r8=stencil
functions.evidence: Derives full rect from bound color +0x3098 or depth +0x30A8 when rect is null; invokes clear core 0x827F10A8.

functions.name: D3DDevice_Clear
functions.signature: r3=device, r4=rect_count, r5=rects, r6=flags, r7=packed_color, f1=depth, r9=stencil
functions.evidence: Converts packed color into float components with VMX128, loops rectangle list and calls ClearF.

functions.name: D3DDevice_BeginVertices
functions.signature: r3=device, r4=primitive, r5=count, r6=stride; returns vertex pointer
functions.evidence: Allocates inline vertex data; saves end ring +0x3484, data +0x3488 and word count +0x3490.

functions.name: D3DDevice_EndVertices
functions.evidence: Copies saved end ring +0x3484 to current ring +0x30.

functions.name: D3DDevice_DrawVerticesUP
functions.evidence: Calls BeginVertices, copies count*stride bytes, then restores end ring +0x3484 to +0x30.

functions.name: D3DDevice_BeginIndexedVertices
functions.signature: r3=device, r4=primitive, r5=base_vertex, r6=vertex_count, r7=index_count, r8=index_format, r9=stride, r10=indices_out; vertices_out at caller stack +0x54
functions.evidence: Allocates inline vertex/index data; stores pointers +0x3488/+0x348C and word counts +0x3490/+0x3494. Indexed UP wrapper supplies negative minimum index as base vertex, then copies the two returned buffers.

functions.name: D3DDevice_DrawIndexedVerticesUP
functions.signature: r3=device, r4=primitive, r5=min_vertex, r6=vertex_count, r7=index_count, r8=index_data, r9=index_format, r10=vertex_data; stride at caller stack +0x54
functions.evidence: Calls BeginIndexedVertices; copies vertex and index arrays; commits saved end ring.

functions.name: D3DDevice_DrawVertices
functions.evidence: Flushes both constant banks and shaders; emits 0xC0012201 draw packet and primitive/count fields.

functions.name: D3DDevice_DrawIndexedVertices
functions.evidence: Flushes constants and shaders; emits 0xC0032201 indexed draw packet using bound indices at +0x3094.

functions.name: D3DDevice_DrawIndexedTessellatedVertices
functions.evidence: Updates tessellation fields +0x2974/+0x2978; flushes constants and shaders; emits indexed draw packet.

functions.name: D3DDevice_Resolve
functions.signature: r3=device, r4=flags, r5=rect, r6=texture, r7=point, r8=level, r9=slice, r10=clear_color, f1=clear_depth; stencil stack ABI pending
functions.evidence: Selects bound color +0x3098 or depth +0x30A8 from flags; handles destination texture, resolve and optional clear work.

functions.name: D3D::RingBufferDeviceAllocate
functions.evidence: Reads byte size through r5, aligns allocation using r6, updates circular side-ring fields +0x3A44/+0x3A4C and handles ring exhaustion.

functions.name: D3D::AllocateInlineData
functions.evidence: Converts dwords to bytes and calls RingBufferDeviceAllocate with flag 1; updates inline byte accounting +0x3A54 and failure flag +0x2ABD bit 0x20.

functions.name: CDevice::SetFence
functions.signature: r3=device, r4=packet_cursor; returns advanced packet cursor
functions.evidence: Emits EVENT_WRITE_SHD packets, records ring state, conditionally updates completion words immediately when +0x541C is zero and +0x2ABD mask 0x02 is set, increments +0x2A9C by two.

functions.name: CDevice::BlockOnFence
functions.signature: r3=device, r4=fence, r5=blocker_type, r6=unconfirmed, r7=no_kick_guard; complete ABI requires runtime trace
functions.evidence: Compares unsigned distances from +0x2A9C to requested and completed fences through +0x2A90. Conditionally calls KickOff, then polls CBlocker::Check until completion.

functions.name: CDevice::KickOffSegment
functions.evidence: Ends the current segment; calls SetFence and appends indirect buffer records or submits the hardware ring; updates segment bookkeeping.

functions.name: CDevice::KickOff
functions.evidence: Prepares segment data, calls KickOffSegment and optionally waits on the prior fence through BlockOnFence before returning device +0x30.

functions.name: D3DDevice_IsFencePending
functions.signature: r3=fence; device comes from VdGlobalDevice import selected by process type
functions.evidence: Loads global device via 0x82000818/0x8200081C; kicks when fence equals current +0x2A9C; compares requested/completed unsigned distances using completion pointer +0x2A90.

functions.name: D3DDevice_Swap
functions.evidence: Increments swap count at device +0x40B0 and calls VdSwap at 0x827F7AC8; r3=device, r4=front texture, r5=parameters.
